home.aboutP1: fernn is a Discord bot built with TypeScript and Bun, using discord.js v14. Everything runs through modern slash commands—no prefix spam, clear permissions, and straightforward moderation and utility tools for your community.
home.aboutP2: Optional server logging stores only your log-channel settings in MongoDB (not a history archive); events show up as rich embeds in the channel you choose. Terms of Service and Privacy Policy stay linked from this site for transparency and the Developer Portal.
home.commandsFootnote: /server-icon includes an add-image subcommand for updating the guild icon workflow from chat.
home.legalStripDescription: Terms and Privacy for the fernn application—use these URLs in the Discord Developer Portal and share them with moderators.

slashFirst.title: Slash-first experience
slashFirst.description: Discoverable commands, built-in validation, and ephemeral errors when something goes wrong—aligned with how Discord apps work today.

moderation.title: Moderation toolkit
moderation.description: Ban, kick, timed mute, nickname changes, and bulk clear with shared guild checks so only the right roles can act.

serverInsight.title: Server & member insight
serverInsight.description: Rich /user-info and /server-info embeds with badges, roles, and server metadata to help staff make faster decisions.

serverLogging.title: Configurable server logging
serverLogging.description: Point /server-log at a channel, tune categories, and let joins, leaves, profile changes, and moderation audit events land in one place.

stack.title: Bun + TypeScript stack
stack.description: Fast cold starts on Bun, strict TypeScript, and discord.js v14 REST routes—great for contributors who want a clean codebase.

docker.title: Docker-ready
docker.description: Ship the same process in containers, register commands globally or per guild, and keep secrets out of source control via environment variables.

mute.description: Apply a timed mute (timeout) with duration and optional reason.

nickname.description: Set or reset another member's nickname when you have permission.

clear.description: Bulk-delete recent messages in the current text channel.

userInfo.name: /user-info
userInfo.description: Inspect a user's profile, flags, roles, and join details.

serverInfo.description: Summarize guild stats, boosts, channels, and verification level.

serverLog.name: /server-log
serverLog.description: Open the logging panel to pick a channel and toggle event categories.

serverIcon.description: Manage the guild icon from Discord, including an add-image subcommand.
